Name: Lance(SVE) To NPC Adventures
Author: KiraMods
Description:
[center][size=3]This is a content pack for adding Lance from [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]) to [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582?tab=description]It's Time to Adventure (NPC Adventures)[/url]﻿ (by [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68185132]PurrplingCat[/url]﻿), making him a full recruitable companion.[/size]

[size=3]We had a lot of fun creating Lance as canon as possible. He has a variety of dialogue, so we hope you'll have fun taking him around the valley.[/size]

[b][u][size=4]Buffs and Weapon[/size][/u][/b]﻿
[size=3][spoiler][/size][size=3]Lance gives you +3 Attack buff, and an additional +1 Magnetic Radius and +1 Luck as a spouse. [/size]
[size=3]He starts with a Galaxy Sword and upgrades as you level your combat skill, so he's OP. Exactly what he deserves.[/spoiler][/size][size=3][/size][size=3][/size]

[b][size=4][u]Install[/u][/size][/b]
[size=3]1. [url=http://smapi.io/]Download and install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Download Stardew Valley Expanded.[/url]﻿
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4582]Download NPC Adventures.[/url]﻿
4. Download this content pack.
5. Unzip and drop everything into your mods folder.
6. Launch the game via SMAPI.
7. Enjoy!

[b][u]IF2R Fix[/u][/b]
Fixes the spring on the Immersive Farm 2 Reimagined map, so companions can now exit the spring.
Unzip and drop into your mods folder if you're using this map.[/size]

[b][size=4][u]Future Updates[/u][/size][/b]
[size=3]The dialogue might expand upon SVEs updates
Might add events[/size][/center]
